@roblox/enum/LineJoinMode.documentation: This enum is used by UIStroke.LineJoinMode to determine how corners are interpreted.

@roblox/enum/ListDisplayMode.documentation: Used to set the scrolling mode of the Advanced Objects tab.

@roblox/enum/LoadCharacterLayeredClothin.documentation:
The behavior of the default setting is not constant. It can mean Disabled
or Enabled depending on what the global back-end flag settings are
currently.

This means layered clothing will not be equipped on characters in the
experience.
This means layered clothing will be equipped on characters in the experience (Although MeshPartHeadsAndAccessories also need to be enabled for the experience).

Indicates whether characters spawning into an experience will have layered
clothing accessories equipped on them.

@roblox/enum/MaterialPattern.Regular.documentation: Material has ordered pattern, usually man-made, like brick or wood planks.

@roblox/enum/MaterialPattern.Organic.documentation: Material pattern has less repetition, like stone or dirt.

@roblox/enum/MaterialPattern.documentation: Describes the pattern of material. Affects texture tiling method.

@roblox/enum/MembershipType.None.documentation: The player does not have an active paid membership.

@roblox/enum/MembershipType.Premium.documentation: The player has an active Premium membership.

@roblox/enum/MembershipType.documentation: The membership type of a Player.

@roblox/enum/MeshPartDetailLevel.Distanc.documentation: Select level of detail based on distance (default behavior as in game).

@roblox/enum/MeshPartDetailLevel.documentation: The level of detail of MeshParts displayed in Studio.

@roblox/enum/MeshPartHeadsAndAccessories.documentation: The default option to control the Workspace.MeshPartHeadsAndAccessories feature. This currently has the same meaning as "Enabled".

@roblox/enum/MeshType.Head.documentation: The mesh is the default Humanoid head mesh.

@roblox/enum/MeshType.Torso.documentation: The mesh is the default Humanoid torso mesh.

@roblox/enum/MeshType.FileMesh.documentation: The mesh is determined by the Roblox mesh asset id provided.

@roblox/enum/MeshType.Brick.documentation: The mesh is a brick (just like the shape of a default BasePart).

@roblox/enum/MeshType.ParallelRamp.documentation: The mesh is a parallel ramp.

@roblox/enum/MeshType.RightAngleRamp.documentation: The mesh is a right angle ramp.

@roblox/enum/MeshType.CornerWedge.documentation: The mesh is a corner wedge.

@roblox/enum/MeshType.documentation: The MeshType Enum is used to set what type of mesh the SpecialMesh is.

@roblox/enum/MessageType.MessageOutput.documentation: The message is from the standard output channel.

@roblox/enum/MessageType.MessageInfo.documentation: The message is from the information channel.

@roblox/enum/MessageType.MessageWarning.documentation: The message is from the warning channel.

@roblox/enum/MessageType.MessageError.documentation: The message is from the error channel.

@roblox/enum/MouseBehavior.Default.documentation: The mouse moves freely around the user's screen.

@roblox/enum/MouseBehavior.LockCenter.documentation:
The mouse is locked, and cannot move from, the center of the user's
screen.

@roblox/enum/MouseBehavior.LockCurrentPo.documentation:
The mouse is locked, and cannot move from, it's current position on the
user's screen at the time of locking.

@roblox/enum/MoveState.Coasting.documentation: Skateboard is coasting (not actively speeding up / being pushed).

@roblox/enum/MoveState.Stopping.documentation: Skateboard is stopping, but still moving.

@roblox/enum/NameOcclusion.NoOcclusion.documentation: Do not occlude (hide) any humanoid names.

@roblox/enum/NameOcclusion.documentation: The NameOcclusion Enum is used to set the Humanoid.NameOcclusion property.

@roblox/enum/NetworkOwnership.Automatic.documentation: Network ownership is determined automatically by the server.

@roblox/enum/NetworkOwnership.Manual.documentation: Network ownership is set manually by the developer.

@roblox/enum/NetworkOwnership.OnContact.documentation:
The first player to touch a part is given ownership of that part for the
server (network). Ownership will not change if another player touches that
part unless network ownership has been released by the owner.

@roblox/enum/NetworkOwnership.documentation:
Defines how simulation authority is determined for the Network Ownership
Unit/Mechanism this part is attached to.

@roblox/enum/NormalId.Top.documentation: The top face of a Part.

@roblox/enum/NormalId.Bottom.documentation: The bottom face of a Part.

@roblox/enum/NormalId.Back.documentation: The back face of a Part.

@roblox/enum/NormalId.Front.documentation: The front face of a Part.

@roblox/enum/NormalId.Right.documentation: The right face of a Part.

@roblox/enum/NormalId.Left.documentation: The left face of a Part.

@roblox/enum/NormalId.documentation: The NormalId Enum sets which side/face of a Part is used.

@roblox/enum/OrientationAlignmentMode.documentation: The OrientationAlignmentMode Enum is used to select the number of Attachments used in an alignment.

@roblox/enum/OutputLayoutMode.documentation: Sets the layout mode of the output.

@roblox/enum/OverrideMouseIconBehavior.N.documentation: The mouse icon behavior is not overridden - default behavior is used.

@roblox/enum/OverrideMouseIconBehavior.F.documentation: The mouse icon is forced to always remain shown/visible.
The mouse icon is forced to always remain hidden/invisible.

@roblox/enum/OverrideMouseIconBehavior.documentation:
Overrides the behavior of the mouse icon to either force that it is always
shown or force that it is always hidden.

@roblox/enum/PackagePermission.None.documentation: Permission data is not available for the current user or group roleset.

@roblox/enum/PackagePermission.NoAccess.documentation: The current user or group roleset doesn't have access.

@roblox/enum/PackagePermission.Revoked.documentation: The current user's or group roleset's permission is revoked.

@roblox/enum/PackagePermission.UseView.documentation:
The current user or group roleset can download a copy of the package from
Roblox.

@roblox/enum/PackagePermission.Edit.documentation:
The current user or group roleset can download a copy of the package from
Roblox and publish package changes to Roblox.

@roblox/enum/PackagePermission.Own.documentation:
The current user or group roleset can download a copy of the page from
Roblox, publish package changes to Roblox, and manage who has access to
the package.

@roblox/enum/PackagePermission.documentation: Indicates the current user's or group roleset's permission to the package.

@roblox/enum/PathStatus.ClosestNoPath.documentation: Path doesn't exist, returns path to closest point.

@roblox/enum/PathStatus.ClosestOutOfRang.documentation:
Goal is out of MaxDistance range, returns path to closest point you can
reach within MaxDistance.

@roblox/enum/PathStatus.FailStartNotEmpt.documentation: Failed to compute path; the starting point is not empty.

@roblox/enum/PathStatus.FailFinishNotEmp.documentation: Failed to compute path; the finish point is not empty.

@roblox/enum/PathStatus.documentation: The success of a Path generated by PathfindingService.

@roblox/enum/PathWaypointAction.Walk.documentation: Walk action needed to reach the next waypoint.

@roblox/enum/PathWaypointAction.Jump.documentation: Jump action needed to reach the next waypoint.

@roblox/enum/PathWaypointAction.documentation: Describes the action to take when a PathWaypoint is reached.

@roblox/enum/PermissionLevelShown.Game.documentation: Member must have no security permissions in order to be shown.

@roblox/enum/PermissionLevelShown.Roblox.documentation: Member must have security permissions less than or equal to RobloxPlaceSecurity to be shown.
Member must have security permissions less than or equal to RobloxScriptSecurity to be shown.

@roblox/enum/PermissionLevelShown.Studio.documentation: Member must have security permissions less than or equal to LocalUserSecurity to be shown.

@roblox/enum/PermissionLevelShown.Roblox.documentation: Member is shown no matter what security it has.

@roblox/enum/PermissionLevelShown.documentation:
Used to set the highest permission level that APIs have to have in order to be
shown in the Object Browser.

@roblox/enum/PhysicsSteppingMethod.Fixed.documentation:
All simulated assemblies inside the workspace will advance forward at 240
Hz. This option is best for optimal stability and simulation accuracy.

@roblox/enum/PhysicsSteppingMethod.Adapt.documentation:
The engine attempts to assign optimal simulation rates for individual
assemblies of either 240 Hz, 120 Hz, or 60 Hz. This setting is optimized
for performance.

@roblox/enum/Platform.Windows.documentation: The client is running on a Windows Operating System.

@roblox/enum/Platform.OSX.documentation: The client is running on OSX (Apple desktop).

@roblox/enum/Platform.IOS.documentation: The client is running on IOS (Apple mobile).

@roblox/enum/Platform.Android.documentation: The client is running on Android (Google mobile).

@roblox/enum/Platform.XBoxOne.documentation: The client is running on an XBox One (console).

@roblox/enum/Platform.PS4.documentation: The client is running on a PS4 (console).

@roblox/enum/Platform.PS3.documentation: The client is running on a PS3 (console).

@roblox/enum/Platform.XBox360.documentation: The client is running on an XBox 360 (console).

@roblox/enum/Platform.WiiU.documentation: The client is running on a Wii U (console).

@roblox/enum/Platform.NX.documentation: The client is running on an NX Operating System (Cisco Nexus).

@roblox/enum/Platform.Ouya.documentation: The client is running on an Ouya Operating System (Android-Based).

@roblox/enum/Platform.AndroidTV.documentation: The client is running on an Android TV.

@roblox/enum/Platform.Chromecast.documentation: The client is running on Chromecast.

@roblox/enum/Platform.Linux.documentation: The client is running on a Linux Operating System (desktop).

@roblox/enum/Platform.SteamOS.documentation: The client is running on Steam.

@roblox/enum/Platform.WebOS.documentation: The client is running on WebOS.

@roblox/enum/Platform.DOS.documentation: The client is running on DOS.

@roblox/enum/Platform.BeOS.documentation: The client is running on BeOS.

@roblox/enum/Platform.UWP.documentation: The client is running on UWP.

@roblox/enum/Platform.None.documentation: The client's operating system is unknown.

@roblox/enum/Platform.documentation: Host operating system of the client.

@roblox/enum/PlaybackState.Begin.documentation: The tween is beginning to play.

@roblox/enum/PlaybackState.Playing.documentation: The tween is currently in progress.

@roblox/enum/PlaybackState.Paused.documentation: The tween is paused in the middle of playing.

@roblox/enum/PlaybackState.Cancelled.documentation: The tween was cancelled before completion.

@roblox/enum/PlayerActions.documentation: References a movement action taken by a player.

@roblox/enum/PlayerChatType.All.documentation: A global message that everyone can receive.

@roblox/enum/PlayerChatType.Team.documentation: A team message only players in the same team can receive.

@roblox/enum/PlayerChatType.Whisper.documentation: A whispered message only the person it's whispered to can receive.

@roblox/enum/PlayerChatType.documentation: Determines the style of a chat message.

@roblox/enum/PoseEasingDirection.Out.documentation:
EasingStyle curves are applied in the forward direction, from the current
keyframe to the next.

@roblox/enum/PoseEasingDirection.InOut.documentation:
Two easing curves are applied back-to-back with the linear ends of the
curves meeting in the middle.

@roblox/enum/PoseEasingDirection.In.documentation:
The EasingStyle curve is reversed, with the easing becoming linear as it
approaches the next keyframe.

@roblox/enum/PoseEasingDirection.documentation:
Used exclusively by Pose.EasingDirection to specify direction of the
EasingStyle curve.

@roblox/enum/PositionAlignmentMode.documentation: The PositionAlignmentMode Enum is used to select the number of Attachments used in an alignment.

@roblox/enum/ProductLocationRestriction..documentation: Item is purchasable only in the Avatar Shop.

Item is purchasable in the Avatar Shop and experiences owned by the item
creator.
(Default) Item is purchasable in the Avatar Shop and all experiences.

@roblox/enum/ProductPurchaseDecision.Not.documentation: The purchase request has been sent but not yet processed.

@roblox/enum/ProductPurchaseDecision.Pur.documentation:
The purchase has been processed and granted to the user who initiated the
purchase request.

@roblox/enum/ProductPurchaseDecision.documentation: The ProductPurchaseDecisionEnum is used to work with MarketplaceService, and the sale of developer products.

@roblox/enum/ProximityPromptExclusivity..documentation: Only one prompt will be shown with this setting.
One prompt will be shown per input enum.KeyCode.
This prompt will always show when in range and visible.

@roblox/enum/ProximityPromptStyle.Custom.documentation: Custom prompt UI style as set by the developer. For more information, see ProximityPrompt.Style.

@roblox/enum/QualityLevel.Automatic.documentation:
The quality level of graphics is determined automatically depending on the
client's setting for either game performance or graphic quality.

@roblox/enum/QualityLevel.Level01.documentation: Graphic quality level 1 - the lowest quality level.

@roblox/enum/QualityLevel.Level21.documentation: Graphic quality level 21, the highest quality level.

@roblox/enum/QualityLevel.documentation: Controls the rendering quality of the game.

@roblox/enum/R15CollisionType.OuterBox.documentation: Dynamically sized collision boxes based on mesh sizes.

@roblox/enum/R15CollisionType.InnerBox.documentation: Fixed size collision boxes, similar to the classic avatar collision.

@roblox/enum/R15CollisionType.documentation: Collision behavior type for a R15 character.

@roblox/enum/RaycastFilterType.Blacklist.documentation: Every BasePart in the game will be considered except those that are descendants of objects in the filter list.

@roblox/enum/RaycastFilterType.Whitelist.documentation: Only BasePart which are descendants of objects in the filter list will be considered in the raycast operation.

@roblox/enum/RaycastFilterType.documentation: Used in a datatype.RaycastParams object to determine how its FilterDescendantsInstances list will be used.

@roblox/enum/RenderFidelity.Automatic.documentation:
Dynamically control a solid-modeled and mesh part's level of detail
depending on its distance from the camera (see table above).

@roblox/enum/RenderFidelity.Precise.documentation:
Specifically set a solid-modeled and mesh part's level of detail
regardless of its distance from the camera (lowest, medium, or highest).

@roblox/enum/RenderFidelity.Performance.documentation:
Push performance as much as possible, trying to maintain quality if
possible, and discarding appearance if that's necessary to reach
performance. This means that the performance will always be excellent, but
mesh visuals may be affected negatively.

@roblox/enum/RenderFidelity.documentation:
This enum determines the level of detail that solid-modeled and mesh parts
will be shown in.

@roblox/enum/RenderPriority.Last.documentation: This should run as last, after Character.

@roblox/enum/RenderPriority.documentation: A list of standard reserved values in BindToRenderStep.

@roblox/enum/ResamplerMode.Default.documentation: Bilinear filtering of the four near pixels in the image.

@roblox/enum/ResamplerMode.Pixelated.documentation: Nearest neighbor filtering of the closest pixel in the image.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.NoReverb.documentation: No sound reverb. Audio is not changed from default.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.GenericReverb.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to a generic reverb effect.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.PaddedCell.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a padded cell.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.Room.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a room.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.Bathroom.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is a bathroom.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.LivingRoom.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a living room.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.StoneRoom.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a stone room.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.Auditorium.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in an auditorium.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.ConcertHall.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a concert hall.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.Cave.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a cave.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.Arena.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in an arena.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.Hangar.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a hangar.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.CarpettedHallway.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a carpeted hallway.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.Hallway.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a hallway.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.StoneCorridor.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is a stone corridor.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.Alley.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in an alley.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.Forest.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a forest.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.City.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in city.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.Mountains.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in the mountains.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.Quarry.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a quarry.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.Plain.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is an open plain.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.ParkingLot.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a parking lot.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.SewerPipe.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a sewer pipe.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.UnderWater.documentation: Sound reverb makes it sound like the player is under water.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.documentation:
The ReverbType Enum allows you to make audio in your game sound different,
depending on what "area" the sounds are in.

@roblox/enum/RigType.documentation: The type of rig being imported with the Avatar Importer.

@roblox/enum/RollOffMode.Inverse.documentation: Volume attenuates from Sound.RollOffMinDistance in an inverse manner.

@roblox/enum/RollOffMode.Linear.documentation: Volume attenuates between Sound.RollOffMinDistance and Sound.RollOffMaxDistance with a linear relationship.

@roblox/enum/RollOffMode.LinearSquare.documentation: Volume attenuates between Sound.RollOffMinDistance and Sound.RollOffMaxDistance with a linear squared relationship.

@roblox/enum/RollOffMode.InverseTapered.documentation: A hybrid model. Follows the Inverse model when close to Sound.RollOffMinDistance and the Linear Square model when close to Sound.RollOffMaxDistance.

@roblox/enum/RollOffMode.documentation: How 3D Sound attenuate (fade out) as the distance between the listener and the Sound's parent increases.

@roblox/enum/RotationOrder.XYZ.documentation: Applies rotations in order X, Y, Z.

@roblox/enum/RotationOrder.XZY.documentation: Applies rotations in order X, Z, Y.

@roblox/enum/RotationOrder.YZX.documentation: Applies rotations in order Y, Z, X.

@roblox/enum/RotationOrder.YXZ.documentation: Applies rotations in order Y, X, Z.

@roblox/enum/RotationOrder.ZXY.documentation: Applies rotations in order Z, X, Y.

@roblox/enum/RotationOrder.ZYX.documentation: Applies rotations in order Z, Y, X.

@roblox/enum/RotationOrder.documentation: The order of rotation axes used for Euler Angles encoding of rotations.

@roblox/enum/ScaleType.Stretch.documentation: The image is stretched to fit within the element.

@roblox/enum/ScaleType.Slice.documentation: 9-Slice scaling: slice the image into 9 regions and apply different scaling rules to each region. The slice boundaries are determined by ImageLabel.SliceCenter or ImageButton.SliceCenter. See UI 9 Slice Design for more information.

@roblox/enum/ScaleType.Tile.documentation:
The image is is tiled to fit within the element. For example, if the
element is twice the X dimension of the image, the image will appear twice
(2 tiles).

@roblox/enum/ScaleType.Fit.documentation:
The image is scaled fit within the element X or Y dimension (whichever
fits first).

@roblox/enum/ScaleType.Crop.documentation: The image is cropped to fit within the element.

@roblox/enum/ScaleType.documentation: Determines how an image (of a ImageLabel or ImageButton) is scaled.

@roblox/enum/ScreenOrientation.Landscape.documentation:
A preference where the game is displayed landscape (horizontally) with the
bottom of the device on the left side of the screen.

A preference where the game is displayed landscape (horizontally) with the
bottom of the device on the right side of the screen.

A preference where the game is displayed landscape (horizontally) with the
bottom of the device on the left of right side of the screen depending on
the device's orientation (the sensor determines which side allows for the
game to be displayed right-side-up).

@roblox/enum/ScreenOrientation.Portrait.documentation:
A preference where the game is displayed portrait (vertically) with the
bottom of the device on the bottom of the screen.

@roblox/enum/ScreenOrientation.Sensor.documentation:
A preference where the game is displayed depending on the best match to
the device's current orientation - either landscape (left/right) or
portrait.

@roblox/enum/ScreenOrientation.documentation: The preference of in-game screen orientation on hand-held devices.

@roblox/enum/ScrollBarInset.None.documentation: The ScrollingFrame will never be insetted for this scrolling bar.

@roblox/enum/ScrollBarInset.ScrollBar.documentation: The ScrollingFrame will only be insetted if this scrollbar is being shown.

@roblox/enum/ScrollBarInset.Always.documentation:
The ScrollingFrame will always be insetted regardless if the scrollbar is
being shown or not.

@roblox/enum/ScrollBarInset.documentation: Indicates when the ScrollingFrame should be insetted by the space needed to show the scroll bar.

@roblox/enum/ScrollingDirection.X.documentation: Canvas can only be scrolled along the X axis.

@roblox/enum/ScrollingDirection.Y.documentation: Canvas can only be scrolled along the Y axis.

@roblox/enum/ScrollingDirection.XY.documentation: Canvas can be scrolled along both X and Y axes.

@roblox/enum/ScrollingDirection.documentation: This enum is used by ScrollingFrame.ScrollingDirection to specify the direction scrolling is allowed.

@roblox/enum/SelectionBehavior.Escape.documentation:
Prioritizes GuiObjects within the same SelectionGroup but allows the
selection to move to other outside GuiObjects if no suitable button is
found.

@roblox/enum/SelectionBehavior.Stop.documentation: Constrains gamepad selection to the SelectionGroup.

@roblox/enum/SelectionBehavior.documentation: Customization options for gamepad selection when GuiBase2d.SelectionGroup is true.

@roblox/enum/SizeConstraint.RelativeXY.documentation: The scale of X and Y are independent.

@roblox/enum/SizeConstraint.RelativeXX.documentation: The scale of X is shared with Y.

@roblox/enum/SizeConstraint.RelativeYY.documentation: The scale of Y is shared with X.

@roblox/enum/SizeConstraint.documentation: Used to constrain the scale of a GUI object.

@roblox/enum/SortOrder.Name.documentation: Elements will be ordered by their Instance.Name in alphabetical order (e.g. Apple will be placed before Banana).

@roblox/enum/SortOrder.Custom.documentation: Deprecated. Elements are ordered by the function passed to UIGridStyleLayout.SetCustomSortFunction.

@roblox/enum/SortOrder.LayoutOrder.documentation: Elements will be ordered by GuiObject.LayoutOrder in ascending order (e.g. 0 will be placed before 1).

@roblox/enum/SortOrder.documentation: Used by UIGridStyleLayout.SortOrder to order the elements in the layout.

@roblox/enum/StartCorner.TopLeft.documentation: Grid starts in top left corner.

@roblox/enum/StartCorner.TopRight.documentation: Grid starts in top right corner.

@roblox/enum/StartCorner.BottomLeft.documentation: Grid starts in bottom left corner.

@roblox/enum/StartCorner.BottomRight.documentation: Grid starts in bottom right corner.

@roblox/enum/StartCorner.documentation: Used by UIGridLayout.StartCorner to decide where the first element is placed.

@roblox/enum/Status.documentation: The purpose of this Enum is unknown.

@roblox/enum/StreamingPauseMode.Default.documentation: Default behavior (currently no change to gameplay).

@roblox/enum/StreamingPauseMode.Disabled.documentation: No change to gameplay due to streaming region availability.

@roblox/enum/StreamingPauseMode.documentation:
Determines how a Players client should handle not having enough content
streamed in to continue playing properly.

@roblox/enum/StreamOutBehavior.Default.documentation:
Currently equivalent to LowMemory. This will eventually change to
Opportunistic.

@roblox/enum/StreamOutBehavior.LowMemory.documentation: Only stream out when memory is low.

@roblox/enum/StreamOutBehavior.Opportuni.documentation:
Stream out content that is significantly outside of the current
StreamingRadius.

@roblox/enum/StreamOutBehavior.documentation: Determines how content is streamed away from Players.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.MainB.documentation: The primary background color used by the ribbon bar and windows.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.Title.documentation: The color of windows' title bars.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.Dropd.documentation: The color of dropdown menus, like those found in the Properties window.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.Toolt.documentation:
The background color of tooltips, like those seen when hovering over
buttons on the ribbon bar or properties in the Properties window.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.Scrol.documentation: The color of scrollbar handles, like those seen in the Explorer window.

The background color of scrollbars, like those seen in the Explorer
window.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.TabBa.documentation:
The background color of the tab bar, like the one where the script editor
is opened.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.Tab.documentation:
The color of tabs on the tab bar, like the ones opened when the script
editor is opened.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.Ribbo.documentation: The color of a tab on the ribbon menu (e.g. Home, Model, Test).
The background color of the ribbon menu.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.Butto.documentation: The background color of clickable buttons.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.MainB.documentation: The background color of clickable buttons that are the primary action.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.Ribbo.documentation: The background color of buttons on the ribbon menu.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.ViewP.documentation: The background color of the game viewport.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.Input.documentation:
The background color of input fields, like those found in the Explorer
window.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.GameS.documentation: The color of items within tables in the game settings window.
The color of tooltips in the game settings window.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.Emula.documentation: The color of the bar shown when the mobile emulator is active.
The color of the device and physical size dropdowns in the emulator bar.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.Color.documentation: The background color of the color picker.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.Borde.documentation: The color of borders, like those found in the Properties window.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.Shado.documentation: The color of shadows rendered under floating items like dropdowns.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.Statu.documentation:
The color of the status bar shown at the bottom of Studio, if it is
visible.

@roblox/enum/Style.BridgeStyleSupports.documentation: Truss beams contain bridge style supports.

@roblox/enum/Style.NoSupports.documentation: Truss beams do not contain supports.

@roblox/enum/Style.documentation: The Style Enum is used to set what style of supports the TrussPart has.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceConstraint.Hinge.documentation:
Makes the side appear with a yellow hinge. Any part connected to this
hinge will stick to the side and rotate using physics.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceConstraint.SteppingM.documentation:
Functions identically to a motor. It may have functioned differently in
the past, but that functionality no longer seems to exist.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceConstraint.Motor.documentation:
Acts the same as a Hinge, but has a grey ring around it and automatically
rotates any part connected to it.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceConstraint.documentation: This item is deprecated and is replaced by the Enum.SurfaceType enum.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceGuiSizingMode.FixedS.documentation: Renders with a fixed size set using SurfaceGui.CanvasSize.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceGuiSizingMode.Pixels.documentation: Renders with a variable size based on SurfaceGui.PixelsPerStud and the SurfaceGui's size in studs.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceGuiSizingMode.documentation: Used by SurfaceGui.SizingMode to control the sizing behavior of a SurfaceGui.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceType.Smooth.documentation: Makes the side appear without any surface detail (except for outlines).

@roblox/enum/SurfaceType.Glue.documentation: Makes the side appear with thick diagonal "X"s.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceType.Weld.documentation: Makes the side appear with thick diagonal "X"s.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceType.Studs.documentation: Makes the side appear with square studs.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceType.Inlet.documentation: Makes the side appear with holes where studs would be.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceType.Universal.documentation: Makes the side appear with both Studs and Inlets in a checker pattern.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceType.Hinge.documentation: Makes the side appear with a yellow hinge. Any part connected to this hinge will stick to the side and rotate using physics, however, using HingeConstraint to join parts is preferred.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceType.Motor.documentation: Acts the same as a Hinge, but has a grey ring around it and automatically rotates any part connected to it, however, using HingeConstraint to join parts is preferred.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceType.SteppingMotor.documentation:
Functions identically to a motor. It may have functioned differently in
the past, but that functionality no longer seems to exist.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceType.SmoothNoOutline.documentation: Same as Smooth, but removes the outlines of the surface.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceType.documentation:
Used to determine how a surface should be displayed on a part and how
automatic surface joints should behave.

@roblox/enum/SwipeDirection.None.documentation: The user did not swipe in a certain direction.

@roblox/enum/SwipeDirection.documentation: The direction that a user is swiping on their touch screen.

@roblox/enum/TableMajorAxis.RowMajor.documentation: The direct siblings are considered rows.

@roblox/enum/TableMajorAxis.ColumnMajor.documentation: The direct siblings are considered columns.

@roblox/enum/TableMajorAxis.documentation: Used by UITableLayout.MajorAxis to decide whether direct siblings are rows or columns.

@roblox/enum/Technology.Legacy.documentation:
Lighting technology that predates Future-Is-Bright. It is no longer
available.

@roblox/enum/Technology.Voxel.documentation: Future-Is-Bright lighting features. Shadows are created using a 4x4x4 voxel map.

@roblox/enum/Technology.Compatibility.documentation: An approximation of Legacy rendering using newer Future is Bright technology. More details.

@roblox/enum/Technology.ShadowMap.documentation: Future-Is-Bright lighting features. Features crisp shadows.

@roblox/enum/Technology.documentation: The Technology enum represents the different lighting systems available for rendering the 3D world. It is used by the Lighting.Technology property.

@roblox/enum/TeleportResult.Failure.documentation: The teleport failed for an unknown reason!.

@roblox/enum/TeleportResult.GameNotFound.documentation: The game that this player attempted to teleport to could not be found.

@roblox/enum/TeleportResult.GameEnded.documentation: The game that this player attempted to teleport to has ended.

@roblox/enum/TeleportResult.GameFull.documentation: The game that this player attempted to teleport to is full.

@roblox/enum/TeleportResult.Unauthorized.documentation: The player is not authorized to complete this teleport.

@roblox/enum/TeleportResult.Flooded.documentation: Too many teleport requests have been made recently.

@roblox/enum/TeleportResult.IsTeleportin.documentation: The player is currently being teleported.

@roblox/enum/TeleportResult.documentation: Describes the result of a teleport.

@roblox/enum/TeleportState.RequestedFrom.documentation: The server has requested that the client teleport.

@roblox/enum/TeleportState.Started.documentation: The client has started attempting to teleport.

@roblox/enum/TeleportState.WaitingForSer.documentation: The client is waiting for the server to respond to the teleport request.

@roblox/enum/TeleportState.InProgress.documentation:
The teleport is currently in progress. The player usually disconnects and
teleports to the destination after this.

@roblox/enum/TeleportState.documentation: Determines the current teleportation state of a player.

@roblox/enum/TeleportType.ToPlace.documentation: The teleport destination is a place (no specific instance).

@roblox/enum/TeleportType.ToInstance.documentation: The teleport destination is an instance of a place.

@roblox/enum/TeleportType.ToReservedServ.documentation:
The destination of the teleport is a reserved server (a place instance
that is reserved for a select group of players).

@roblox/enum/TeleportType.documentation: Determines the type of teleport destination for a TeleportService teleport call.

@roblox/enum/TextChatMessageStatus.Unkno.documentation: Generic failed status for any other TextChannel.SendAsync failures.

@roblox/enum/TextChatMessageStatus.TextF.documentation: Text filter failed to process the message.

@roblox/enum/TextChatMessageStatus.Flood.documentation: Message is from a user sending messages too frequently.

@roblox/enum/TextChatMessageStatus.Inval.documentation: Message can't be sent because of user's chat privacy settings.
Message's TextSource is either not in the intended TextChannel or TextSource.CanSend is false.

@roblox/enum/TextTruncate.AtEnd.documentation:
Text is truncated at the end of the text, extra graphemes that cannot fit
into the space are replaced with '...'.

@roblox/enum/TextTruncate.documentation: Controls the truncation of text when using the TextTruncate property.

@roblox/enum/TextureMode.Stretch.documentation:
The texture will be stretched out based on the lifetime of the trail, and
will shrink inwards if the trail stops moving.

@roblox/enum/TextureMode.Wrap.documentation:
The texture will be tiled as the length of the trail changes, but the
textures will remain stationary relative to their attachments.

@roblox/enum/TextureMode.Static.documentation:
The texture will be rolled out as the attachments move, and they will
remain in place until their lifetime is met.

@roblox/enum/TextureMode.documentation: Describes how the texture of a Trail or Beam behaves.

@roblox/enum/TextureQueryType.NonHumanoi.documentation: Texture memory for objects other than Humanoid.
Unreferenced texture memory for objects other than Humanoid.

@roblox/enum/TextureQueryType.documentation: Used to get memory information about textures.

@roblox/enum/TextXAlignment.Left.documentation: Alignment starts at the left side of the GUI object.

@roblox/enum/TextXAlignment.Center.documentation:
Aligned starts at the center of the GUI object and spreads equally left
and right.

@roblox/enum/TextXAlignment.Right.documentation: Alignment starts at the right side of the GUI object.

@roblox/enum/TextYAlignment.Top.documentation: Alignment starts at the top of the GUI object.

@roblox/enum/TextYAlignment.Center.documentation:
Aligned starts at the center of the GUI object and spreads equally toward
the top and bottom.

@roblox/enum/TextYAlignment.Bottom.documentation: Alignment starts at the bottom of the GUI object.

@roblox/enum/ThreadPoolConfig.Auto.documentation: Let task scheduler make a decision internally.

@roblox/enum/ThreadPoolConfig.PerCore1.documentation: Utilize 1 worker thread per available physical CPU core.

@roblox/enum/ThreadPoolConfig.PerCore2.documentation: Utilize 2 worker threads per available physical CPU core.

@roblox/enum/ThreadPoolConfig.PerCore3.documentation: Utilize 3 worker threads per available physical CPU core.

@roblox/enum/ThreadPoolConfig.PerCore4.documentation: Utilize 4 worker threads per available physical CPU core.

@roblox/enum/ThreadPoolConfig.Threads1.documentation: Utilize 1 worker thread, ignore the physical CPU core count.

@roblox/enum/ThreadPoolConfig.Threads2.documentation: Utilize 2 worker threads, ignore the physical CPU core count.

@roblox/enum/ThreadPoolConfig.Threads3.documentation: Utilize 3 worker threads, ignore the physical CPU core count.

@roblox/enum/ThreadPoolConfig.Threads4.documentation: Utilize 4 worker threads, ignore the physical CPU core count.

@roblox/enum/ThreadPoolConfig.Threads8.documentation: Utilize 8 worker threads, ignore the physical CPU core count.

@roblox/enum/ThreadPoolConfig.Threads16.documentation: Utilize 16 worker threads, ignore the physical CPU core count.

@roblox/enum/ThreadPoolConfig.documentation: Thread pooling scheme for the task scheduler.

@roblox/enum/ThrottlingPriority.Elevated.documentation: Less throttling if on the server.

@roblox/enum/ThumbnailSize.Size48x48.documentation: Thumbnail resolution is 48 pixels x 48 pixels.

@roblox/enum/ThumbnailSize.Size180x180.documentation: Thumbnail resolution is 180 pixels x 180 pixels.

@roblox/enum/ThumbnailSize.Size420x420.documentation: Thumbnail resolution is 420 pixels x 420 pixels.

@roblox/enum/ThumbnailSize.Size60x60.documentation: Thumbnail resolution is 60 pixels x 60 pixels.

@roblox/enum/ThumbnailSize.Size100x100.documentation: Thumbnail resolution is 100 pixels x 100 pixels.

@roblox/enum/ThumbnailSize.Size150x150.documentation: Thumbnail resolution is 150 pixels x 150 pixels.

@roblox/enum/ThumbnailSize.Size352x352.documentation: Thumbnail resolution is 352 pixels x 352 pixels.

@roblox/enum/ThumbnailType.HeadShot.documentation:
The returned thumbnail shows just the headshot (head and up) of the user's
avatar.

@roblox/enum/ThumbnailType.AvatarBust.documentation: The returned thumbnail shows the bust (chest up) of the user's avatar.

@roblox/enum/ThumbnailType.AvatarThumbna.documentation: The returned thumbnail shows the entire body of the user's avatar.

@roblox/enum/TickCountSampleMethod.Fast.documentation: Compute time using a faster, but less precise method.

@roblox/enum/TickCountSampleMethod.Bench.documentation:
Dynamically decide between using ''Fast'' and ''Precise'' depending on
performance.

@roblox/enum/TickCountSampleMethod.Preci.documentation: Compute time using a precise method.

@roblox/enum/TickCountSampleMethod.documentation: Controls the precision of a timer.

@roblox/enum/TopBottom.Top.documentation: The object is above its parent.

@roblox/enum/TopBottom.Center.documentation: The object is centered around the center of its parent.

@roblox/enum/TopBottom.Bottom.documentation: The object is below its parent.

@roblox/enum/TopBottom.documentation: Sets where the object is on the side of its parent.

@roblox/enum/TouchCameraMovementMode.Def.documentation: Default mode used by Roblox Core Scripts.

@roblox/enum/TouchCameraMovementMode.Fol.documentation:
Camera moves with the subject and rotates to keep the subject in the
center.

@roblox/enum/TouchCameraMovementMode.Cla.documentation: Default mode used by Roblox Core Scripts.

@roblox/enum/TouchCameraMovementMode.Orb.documentation:
The camera locks at a certain angle. Once it's set, players can rotate the
camera, but it will always maintain a consistent angle to the ground.

@roblox/enum/TouchCameraMovementMode.documentation:
Changes the touch camera movement mode currently in-use by the client using a
TouchEnabled device.

@roblox/enum/TouchMovementMode.Thumbstic.documentation: Change the movement controller to the classic thumbstick.

@roblox/enum/TouchMovementMode.DPad.documentation: Change the movement controller to the DPad.

@roblox/enum/TouchMovementMode.Thumbpad.documentation: Change the movement controller to the thumbpad.

@roblox/enum/TouchMovementMode.ClickToMo.documentation: Change the movement controller to click to move.

@roblox/enum/TouchMovementMode.DynamicTh.documentation: Change the movement controller to the dynamic thumbstick.

@roblox/enum/TouchMovementMode.documentation: The movement mode used by a client with a TouchEnabled device.

@roblox/enum/TweenStatus.Canceled.documentation: The tween was cancelled before completion.

@roblox/enum/TweenStatus.documentation: The completion status of a GuiObject tween function.

@roblox/enum/UiMessageType.documentation: Controls the UI message under the GuiService.

@roblox/enum/UserCFrame.Head.documentation: The CFrame of the user's head.

@roblox/enum/UserCFrame.LeftHand.documentation: The CFrame of the user's left hand.

@roblox/enum/UserCFrame.RightHand.documentation: The CFrame of the user's right hand.

@roblox/enum/UserCFrame.documentation:
Determines what body part is being tracked by a VR device, and what its CFrame
actually is.

@roblox/enum/UserInputState.Begin.documentation: Occurs when an InputObject starts to interact with the game. For example, a mouse button down, or a key down, or when a touch begins touching the screen.

@roblox/enum/UserInputState.Change.documentation: Occurs each frame an InputObject has already begun interacting with the game and part of its state is changing. For example, a movement of the mouse position, a gamepad thumbstick, gamepad trigger button, or screen touch point.

@roblox/enum/UserInputState.End.documentation: When an InputObject finishes interacting with the game. For example, a mouse button up, or a key up, or when a touch stops touching the screen.

@roblox/enum/UserInputState.Cancel.documentation: A special circumstance state that indicates this input is no longer relevant, particularly with ContextActionService. For example, binding two action-handling functions will cause the first to Cancel if an input was already in-progress when the second was bound.

@roblox/enum/UserInputState.None.documentation:
A state that should never be seen in a game, essentially just marks the
end of the enum.

@roblox/enum/UserInputState.documentation: The UserInputState enum describes the state of an input that is currently or was recently performed.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.MouseMovement.documentation:
Movement of the mouse. Fires changed events each time the player's cursor
position changes and when the move enters/leaves the game window.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.Touch.documentation: A tap on the screen from a mobile device.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.Focus.documentation: The client regaining focus of the Roblox window.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.Accelerometer.documentation: The accelerometer of a mobile device.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.Gyro.documentation: The Gyroscope of a mobile device.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.Gamepad1.documentation: Input from the 1st plugged in Gamepad.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.Gamepad2.documentation: Input from the 2nd plugged in Gamepad.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.Gamepad3.documentation: Input from the 3rd plugged in Gamepad.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.Gamepad4.documentation: Input from the 4th plugged in Gamepad.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.Gamepad5.documentation: Input from the 5th plugged in Gamepad.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.Gamepad6.documentation: Input from the 6th plugged in Gamepad.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.Gamepad7.documentation: Input from the 7th plugged in Gamepad.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.Gamepad8.documentation: Input from the 8th plugged in Gamepad.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.TextInput.documentation: Input of Text into a text-based GuiObject. Normally this is only a TextBox.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.InputMethod.documentation: Text input from an input method editor (IME). InputObjects with this type aren't currently fired.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.documentation: Describes the type of a user input event.

@roblox/enum/VelocityConstraintMode.Line.documentation:
The velocity component in the direction of the line is constrained to the specified value. The line direction is based on the RelativeTo property:
  • RelativeTo_Attachment0: The line direction is the primary axis of attachment0.
  • RelativeTo_Attachment1: The line direction is the primary axis of attachment1.
  • RelativeTo_World: The line direction must be specified.

@roblox/enum/VelocityConstraintMode.Plan.documentation:
The velocity components in the plane are constrained to the specified values. The plane tangents are based on the RelativeTo property:
  • RelativeTo_Attachment0: The plane tangents are the two axes of attachment0.
  • RelativeTo_Attachment1: The plane tangents are the two axes of attachment1.
  • RelativeTo_World: The two plane tangents must be specified

@roblox/enum/VelocityConstraintMode.Vect.documentation:
The velocity components must be equal to the vector components specified. The coordinate system of the vector is based on the RelativeTo property:
  • RelativeTo_Attachment0: The vector components are in the coordinate system defined by the axes of attachment0.
  • RelativeTo_Attachment1: The vector components are in the coordinate system defined by the axes of attachment1.
  • RelativeTo_World: The coordinate system is in the world and the vector components must be specified.

@roblox/enum/VelocityConstraintMode.documentation:
The velocity constraint mode property controls how the linear velocity of the
attachment(s) is constrained.

@roblox/enum/VerticalAlignment.documentation:
Determines how grid is placed within it's parent's container in the y
direction.

@roblox/enum/VerticalScrollBarPosition.documentation: Indicates the side that the vertical scrollbar will be located at.

@roblox/enum/VibrationMotor.documentation: Describes the vibration motor size or triggers.

@roblox/enum/VirtualCursorMode.Default.documentation: The Virtual Cursor is in the default state.

@roblox/enum/VirtualCursorMode.documentation: Enables Virtual Cursor mode within an experience.

@roblox/enum/VRTouchpad.documentation:
Used to universally identify a VR touchpad that is used by either the left, or
right hand.

@roblox/enum/VRTouchpadMode.Touch.documentation:
The touchpad is treated as ButtonB if it is the left touchpad, or ButtonA
if it is the right touchpad.

@roblox/enum/VRTouchpadMode.VirtualThumb.documentation: The touchpad will function as a gamepad joystick.

@roblox/enum/VRTouchpadMode.ABXY.documentation:
The touchpad will function as a means of inputting the standard ABXY
gamepad input, dividing it up into 4 diagonal pie slices.

@roblox/enum/VRTouchpadMode.documentation: Used to identify the behavior of a specified VR touchpad.

@roblox/enum/WaterDirection.documentation: This Enum was once used to set the direction of Terrain water.

@roblox/enum/WaterForce.documentation: The WaterForce Enum is used to work with Terrain water cells.

@roblox/enum/WrapLayerDebugMode.None.documentation: This debug rendering mode does nothing. This is the default value.

@roblox/enum/WrapLayerDebugMode.BoundCag.documentation: This debug mode visualizes corresponding cage mesh vertices bound to an underlying WrapTarget. In order to find corresponding vertices between different cages, the Wrap Deformer algorithm uses UV matching. As long as your WrapLayer cage mesh share the same UV layout as WrapTarget, its vertices will be marked as "bound".

@roblox/enum/WrapLayerDebugMode.LayerCag.documentation:
This debug mode shows the resulting layer mesh as a whole. The deformer
will use vertex locations from the previous layer for all unbound
vertices.

@roblox/enum/WrapLayerDebugMode.BoundCag.documentation:
The same as BoundCage but also visualizes how bound vertices were moved.
You can use this mode to identify where they belong on a previous layer
and where they are located on the current layer.

@roblox/enum/WrapLayerDebugMode.Referenc.documentation: This debug mode shows the original inner cage mesh as it was created.

@roblox/enum/WrapLayerDebugMode.Rbf.documentation:
This debug mode visualizes the internal RBF solver state. You can estimate
the wrap deformer's expected behavior by looking at this state. All
renderable mesh vertices move from a "big sphere" to a "small sphere"
along a corresponding line connecting two spheres.

@roblox/enum/WrapLayerDebugMode.OuterCag.documentation: This debug mode shows the original outer cage mesh as it was created.

@roblox/enum/WrapLayerDebugMode.documentation:
The "Editor only" property for quickly visualizing Wrap Deformer internals and
debugging cage mesh-related issues.

@roblox/enum/WrapTargetDebugMode.None.documentation: This debug rendering mode does nothing, and this is the default value.

@roblox/enum/WrapTargetDebugMode.TargetC.documentation: This debug mode shows the original cage mesh as it was created.

This debug mode shows corresponding cage mesh compressed by clothing
layers above it. This debug mode is intended to validate that the
compression algorithm and corresponding cages work as intended.

This debug mode shows the resulting cage mesh for the corresponding Wrap
Instance. This debug mode is intended to validate that the final deformed
cage looks as intended.

@roblox/enum/WrapTargetDebugMode.TargetL.documentation:
The same as TargetCageOriginal but affects all WrapTargets that belong to
the Wrap Deformer simultaneously. It doesn't matter which particular
WrapTarget you enable this debug visualization option.

The same as TargetCageCompressed but affects all WrapTargets that belong
to the Wrap Deformer simultaneously. It doesn't matter which particular
WrapTarget you enable this debug visualization option.

The same as TargetCageInterface but affects all WrapTargets that belong to
the Wrap Deformer simultaneously. It doesn't matter which particular
WrapTarget you enable this debug visualization option.

@roblox/enum/WrapTargetDebugMode.Rbf.documentation:
This debug mode visualizes the internal RBF solver state. You can estimate
the wrap deformer expected behavior by looking at this state. All
renderable mesh vertices move from a "big sphere" to a "small sphere"
along a corresponding line connecting two spheres.

@roblox/enum/WrapTargetDebugMode.documentation:
The "Editor only" property for quickly visualizing Wrap Deformer internals and
debugging cage mesh-related issues.

@roblox/enum/ZIndexBehavior.Global.documentation:
The ZIndex property overrides the default value computed from the depth in
the hierarchy.

@roblox/enum/ZIndexBehavior.Sibling.documentation:
The ZIndex property controls the order in which the GuiObject renders
relative to its siblings.

@roblox/enum/ZIndexBehavior.documentation: Used by LayerCollector.ZIndexBehavior to control how the GuiObject.ZIndex property behaves for descendants.

@luau/global/bit32.documentation: A library of functions to perform bitwise operations.

@luau/global/bit32.arshift/param/0.documentation: The number whose bits shall be shifted.

@luau/global/bit32.arshift/param/1.documentation: The integer number of bits to shift by.

@luau/global/bit32.arshift.documentation:
Returns a number after its bits have been arithmetically shifted to the
right by a given displacement.

@luau/global/bit32.band.documentation: Returns the bitwise and of its operands.

@luau/global/bit32.bnot.documentation: Returns the bitwise negation of a given number.

@luau/global/bit32.bor.documentation: Returns the bitwise or of its operands.

@luau/global/bit32.btest.documentation:
Returns a boolean describing whether the bitwise and of its operands is
different from zero.

@luau/global/bit32.bxor.documentation: Returns the bitwise exclusive or of its operands.

@luau/global/bit32.countlz.documentation:
Returns the number of consecutive zero bits in the 32-bit representation
of the provided number starting from the left-most (most significant) bit.

@luau/global/bit32.countrz.documentation:
Returns the number of consecutive zero bits in the 32-bit representation
of the provided number starting from the right-most (least significant)
bit.

@luau/global/bit32.extract.documentation:
Extract a range of bits from a number and return them as an unsigned
number.

@luau/global/bit32.replace.documentation: Return a copy of a number with a range of bits replaced by a given value.

@luau/global/bit32.lrotate.documentation:
Returns a number after its bits have been rotated to the left by a given
number of times.

@luau/global/bit32.lshift.documentation:
Returns a number whose bits have been logically shifted to the left by a
given displacement.

@luau/global/bit32.rrotate.documentation:
Returns a number after its bits have been rotated to the right by a given
number of times.

@luau/global/bit32.rshift.documentation:
Returns a number whose bits have been logically shifted to the right by a
given displacement.

@luau/global/coroutine.documentation: A function that executes alongside the main thread.

@luau/global/coroutine.close/return/0.documentation: true unless the coroutine being closed is in an error state.

@luau/global/coroutine.close.documentation: Closes and puts the provided coroutine in a dead state.

@luau/global/coroutine.create.documentation: Creates a new coroutine, with body f. f must be a Lua function.

@luau/global/coroutine.isyieldable/retur.documentation: Whether or not the coroutine can safely yield at this point.

@luau/global/coroutine.isyieldable.documentation: Returns true if the coroutine this function is called within can safely yield.

@luau/global/coroutine.resume.documentation: Starts or continues the execution of coroutine co.

@luau/global/coroutine.status.documentation: Returns the status of coroutine co as a string.

@luau/global/coroutine.wrap.documentation:
Creates a new coroutine and returns a function that, when called, resumes
the coroutine.

@luau/global/debug.documentation: This library provides functions useful for debugging and profiling code.

@luau/global/debug.traceback/overload/(s.documentation: The first line of the returned string.
The number of calls "up" the call stack to return.

Returns a string of undefined format that describes the current function
call stack.

@luau/global/debug.traceback/overload/(t.documentation:
Returns a string of undefined format that describes the current function
call stack.

@luau/global/debug.info/overload/(thread.documentation: A thread as returned by coroutine.create, omit entirely to use the current thread.

Determines at what level of the call stack the information returned
should describe.
A string that describes what the returned information should represent. It must only contain 0 or 1 instances of the following characters, each representing a piece of information: slnaf.

Traverses the entire stack of target thread and returns a string
containing the call stack of target level details.

@luau/global/debug.info/overload/(functi.documentation:
Determines at what function of the call stack the information returned
should describe.
A string that describes what the returned information should represent. It must only contain 0 or 1 instances of the following characters, each representing a piece of information: slnaf.

Traverses the entire stack of current thread and returns a string
containing the call stack of target function details.

@luau/global/debug.info/overload/(number.documentation:
Determines at what level of the call stack the information returned
should describe.
Describes what the returned information should represent. It must only contain 0 or 1 instances of the following characters, each representing a piece of information: slnaf.

Traverses the entire stack of current thread and returns a string
containing the call stack of target level details.

@luau/global/debug.profilebegin/param/0.documentation: The text that this MicroProfiler label displays.

@luau/global/debug.profilebegin.documentation: Starts profiling for a MicroProfiler label.

@luau/global/debug.profileend.documentation: Stops profiling for the most recent MicroProfiler label that debug.profilebegin opened.

@luau/global/debug.setmemorycategory.documentation:
Assigns a custom tag to the current thread's memory category in the
Developer Console.

@luau/global/debug.resetmemorycategory.documentation: Resets the tag assigned by debug.setmemorycategory to the automatically assigned value (typically, the script name).

@luau/global/math.abs.documentation: Returns the absolute value of x.

@luau/global/math.acos.documentation: Returns the arc cosine of x.

@luau/global/math.asin.documentation: Returns the arc sine of x.

@luau/global/math.atan.documentation: Returns the arc tangent of x (in radians).

@luau/global/math.atan2.documentation:
Returns the arc tangent of y/x (in radians) while using the signs of both
parameters to find the quadrant of the result.

@luau/global/math.ceil.documentation: Returns the smallest integer larger than or equal to x.

@luau/global/math.cos.documentation: Returns the cosine of x (assumed to be in radians).

@luau/global/math.cosh.documentation: Returns the hyperbolic cosine of x.

@luau/global/math.deg.documentation: Returns the angle x (given in radians) in degrees.

@luau/global/math.floor.documentation: Returns the largest integer smaller than or equal to x.

@luau/global/math.fmod.documentation:
Returns the remainder of the division of x by y that rounds the quotient
towards zero.

@luau/global/math.frexp.documentation: Returns m and e such that x = m*2^e.

@luau/global/math.ldexp.documentation: Returns x*2^e (e should be an integer).

@luau/global/math.log/param/1.documentation: The base of the logarithm, the constant e by default.

@luau/global/math.log.documentation: Returns the logarithm of x using the given base.

@luau/global/math.log10.documentation: Returns the base-10 logarithm of x.

@luau/global/math.max.documentation: Returns the maximum value among the numbers passed to the function.

@luau/global/math.min.documentation: Returns the minimum value among the numbers passed to the function.

@luau/global/math.modf.documentation: Returns two numbers, the integral part of x and the fractional part of x.

@luau/global/math.rad.documentation: Returns the angle x (given in degrees) in radians.

@luau/global/math.random.documentation: Returns a random number within the range provided.

@luau/global/math.randomseed.documentation: Sets x as the seed for the pseudo-random generator.

@luau/global/math.round.documentation:
Returns the integer with the smallest difference between it and the given
number.

@luau/global/math.sign.documentation: Returns -1 if x < 0, 0 if x == 0, or 1 if x > 0.

@luau/global/math.sin.documentation: Returns the sine of x (assumed to be in radians).

@luau/global/math.sinh.documentation: Returns the hyperbolic sine of x.

@luau/global/math.sqrt.documentation: Returns the square root of x.

@luau/global/math.tan.documentation: Returns the tangent of x (assumed to be in radians).

@luau/global/math.tanh.documentation: Returns the hyperbolic tangent of x.

@luau/global/os.documentation: This library provides time and date related functions.

@luau/global/os.time/param/0.documentation: A table describing a specific time, similar to that returned by os.date. If not provided, uses the current UTC time.

@luau/global/os.time.documentation:
Returns how many seconds have passed since the Unix epoch (1 January 1970,
00:00:00) under current UTC time.

@luau/global/os.difftime.documentation:
Returns the number of seconds from t1 to t2, assuming the arguments are
correctly casted to the time_t format.

@luau/global/os.date.documentation:
Formats the given string with date/time information based on the given
time (or if not provided, the value returned by os.time).

@luau/global/os.clock.documentation:
Returns a high-precision amount of CPU time used by Lua in seconds,
intended for use in benchmarking.

@luau/global/string.documentation: Provides generic functions to manipulate strings.

@luau/global/string.byte.documentation: Returns the internal numerical codes of the characters s[i], s[i+1], ..., s[j]. The default value for i is 1; the default value for j is i. These indices are corrected following the same rules of function string.sub.

@luau/global/string.char.documentation:
Receives zero or more integers and returns a string with length equal to
the number of arguments that has each character has the internal numerical
code equal to its corresponding argument.

@luau/global/string.find.documentation: Looks for the first match of pattern in the string s and returns the indices of s where the occurrence starts and ends.

@luau/global/string.format.documentation:
Returns a formatted version of its variable number of arguments following
the description given in its first argument, which must be a string.

@luau/global/string.gmatch.documentation: Returns an iterator function that returns the next captures from pattern over the string s each time it's called.

@luau/global/string.gsub/param/0.documentation: The string whose occurrences of the given pattern shall be replaced.

@luau/global/string.gsub/param/1.documentation: The pattern to be matched and replaced.

@luau/global/string.gsub/param/2.documentation: Determines what should replace the occurrence(s) of the given pattern.

@luau/global/string.gsub/param/3.documentation: The maximum number of substitutions to make.

@luau/global/string.gsub.documentation: Returns a copy of s in which all or the first n occurrences of the pattern are replaced with the given replacement. The second value returned is the total number of substitutions made.

@luau/global/string.len.documentation: Returns the length of a string.

@luau/global/string.lower.documentation:
Returns a copy of a string with all uppercase letters changed to
lowercase.

@luau/global/string.match.documentation: Looks for the first match of pattern in the string s. If a match is found, it is returned; otherwise, it returns nil. A third, optional numerical argument, init, specifies where to start the search.

@luau/global/string.pack.documentation: Returns a binary string containing the provided arguments.

@luau/global/string.packsize.documentation: Returns the size in bytes of any string packed with a given description.

@luau/global/string.rep.documentation: Returns a string that is the concatenation of n copies of the string s.

@luau/global/string.reverse.documentation: Returns a string that is the string s reversed.

@luau/global/string.split/param/1.documentation: The separator character(s) to be used for splitting the string.

@luau/global/string.split.documentation:
Splits a string into parts based on the defined separator character(s),
returning a table of ordered results.

@luau/global/string.sub.documentation: Returns the substring of s that starts at i and continues until j. i and j can be negative. i defaults to 1 and j defaults to -1.

@luau/global/string.unpack/return/0.documentation:
The values packed into the provided binary string, plus the index of
the first unread byte.

@luau/global/string.unpack.documentation: Extracts the values packed in the provided binary string.

@luau/global/string.upper.documentation:
Returns a copy of a string with all lowercase letters changed to
uppercase.

@luau/global/table.clear/param/0.documentation: The table whose keys will be cleared.

@luau/global/table.clear.documentation: Sets all keys in the given table to nil.

@luau/global/table.clone/return/0.documentation: The clone of the provided table.

@luau/global/table.clone.documentation: Returns a shallow copy of the provided table.

@luau/global/table.concat/param/0.documentation: The table that will be converted into a string.

@luau/global/table.concat/param/1.documentation: The string that will be concatenated between each entry in the table.

@luau/global/table.concat/param/2.documentation: The starting index of the table concatenation.

@luau/global/table.concat/param/3.documentation: The ending index of the table concatenation.

@luau/global/table.concat.documentation:
Returns the given range of table elements as a string where each element
is separated by the given separator.

@luau/global/table.create.documentation: Returns a new table populated with many instances of the specified value.

@luau/global/table.find.documentation: Returns the index of the first occurrence of needle within haystack starting from init.

@luau/global/table.foreach/param/0.documentation: The table to be iterated over.

@luau/global/table.foreach/param/1.documentation:
The function that will be used for the iteration. This function will
receive 2 arguments for each iteration, where the 1st argument is the
key, and the 2nd argument is the value.

@luau/global/table.foreach.documentation:
Iterates over the provided table, passing the key and value of each
iteration over to the provided function.

@luau/global/table.foreachi/param/0.documentation: The table to be iterated over.

@luau/global/table.foreachi/param/1.documentation:
The function that will be used for the iteration. This function will
receive 2 arguments for each iteration, where the 1st argument is the
index, and the 2nd argument is the value.

@luau/global/table.foreachi.documentation:
Similar to table.foreach() except index-value pairs are passed instead of
key-value pairs.

@luau/global/table.getn/param/0.documentation: The table whose size is being measured.

@luau/global/table.getn.documentation: Returns the number of elements in the table passed.

@luau/global/table.insert/overload/(tabl.documentation: The table that is being appended to.
The position at which the value will be inserted.
The value that will be appended to the table.
Inserts the provided value to the target position of the array.
The table that is being appended to.
The value that will be appended to the table.
Appends the provided value to the end of the array.

@luau/global/table.isfrozen/return/0.documentation: Whether the table is frozen from table.freeze().

@luau/global/table.isfrozen.documentation: Returns true if the given table is frozen and false if it isn't frozen.

@luau/global/table.maxn.documentation:
Returns the maximum numeric key of the provided table, or zero if the
table has no numeric keys.

@luau/global/table.move.documentation: Moves the specified range of elements from one table to another.

@luau/global/table.pack.documentation: Returns a new table containing the provided values.

@luau/global/table.remove/param/0.documentation: The table that is having an element removed.

@luau/global/table.remove/param/1.documentation: The index of the element being removed.

@luau/global/table.remove.documentation:
Removes the specified element from the array, shifting later elements down
to fill in the empty space if possible.

@luau/global/table.sort/param/1.documentation: An optional comparison function to be used when comparing elements in the table. This function receives two elements, a and b, and should return true if a < b.

@luau/global/table.sort.documentation: Sorts table elements using the provided comparison function or the < operator.

@luau/global/table.unpack.documentation: Returns all elements from the given list as a tuple.

@roblox/global/task.documentation: Allows for functions and threads to be coordinated with the Task Scheduler.

@roblox/global/task.spawn/param/0.documentation: A function or a thread returned by coroutine.create.

@roblox/global/task.spawn/param/1.documentation: Arguments to send to the function or thread.

@roblox/global/task.spawn.documentation:
Calls/resumes a function/coroutine immediately through the engine
scheduler.

@roblox/global/task.defer/param/0.documentation: A function or a thread returned by coroutine.create.

@roblox/global/task.defer/param/1.documentation: Arguments to send to the function or thread.

@roblox/global/task.defer.documentation: Calls/resumes a function/coroutine on the next resumption cycle.

@roblox/global/task.delay/param/0.documentation:
The minimum number of seconds that must pass before the
function/thread is called/resumed.

@roblox/global/task.delay/param/2.documentation:
Arguments to be passed to the function/thread when it is due to be
called/resumed.

@roblox/global/task.delay.documentation:
Schedules a function/coroutine to be called/resumed on the next Heartbeat
after the given duration (in seconds) has passed, without throttling.

@roblox/global/task.desynchronize.documentation: Causes the following code to be run in parallel.

@roblox/global/task.synchronize.documentation: Causes the following code to be run in serial.

@roblox/global/task.wait/param/0.documentation:
The amount of time in seconds that should elapse before the current
thread is resumed.

@roblox/global/task.wait.documentation:
Yields the current thread until the next Heartbeat in which the given
duration (in seconds) has passed, without throttling.

@roblox/global/task.cancel/param/0.documentation: The thread that will be cancelled.

@roblox/global/task.cancel.documentation: Cancels a thread, preventing it from being resumed.

@luau/global/utf8.documentation: This library provides basic support for UTF-8 encoding.

@luau/global/utf8.char.documentation: Converts zero or more codepoints to UTF-8 byte sequences.

@luau/global/utf8.codes.documentation:
Returns an iterator function that iterates over all codepoints in a given
string.

@luau/global/utf8.codepoint/param/1.documentation: The index of the codepoint that should be fetched from this string.

@luau/global/utf8.codepoint/param/2.documentation: The index of the last codepoint between i and j that will be returned. If excluded, this will default to the value of i.

@luau/global/utf8.codepoint.documentation:
Returns the codepoints (as integers) from all codepoints in a given
string.

@luau/global/utf8.len.documentation: Returns the number of UTF-8 codepoints in a given string.

@luau/global/utf8.offset.documentation: Returns the position (in bytes) where the encoding of the n-th codepoint of s (counting from byte position i) starts.

@luau/global/utf8.graphemes.documentation:
Returns an iterator function that iterates over the grapheme clusters of a
given string.

@luau/global/utf8.nfcnormalize.documentation: Converts the input string to Normal Form C.

@luau/global/utf8.nfdnormalize.documentation: Converts the input string to Normal Form D.

@luau/global/assert/param/0.documentation: The value that will be asserted against.

@luau/global/assert/param/1.documentation: The text that will be shown in the error if the assertion fails.

@luau/global/assert.documentation: Throws an error if the provided value resolves to false or nil.

@luau/global/collectgarbage/param/0.documentation:
The name of the operation that should be performed by the garbage
collector.

@luau/global/collectgarbage.documentation: Performs the specified operation of the garbage collector.

@luau/global/error/param/1.documentation: The level of information that should be printed. Defaults to 1.

@luau/global/error.documentation: Halts thread execution and throws an error.

@luau/global/getfenv/param/0.documentation:
The stack level (int) of the environment to be returned; or the
function whose environment will be returned.

@luau/global/getfenv.documentation: Returns a function's environment as a dictionary.

@luau/global/getmetatable/param/0.documentation: The object to fetch the metatable of.

@luau/global/getmetatable.documentation: Returns the metatable of the given table.

@luau/global/ipairs/param/0.documentation: A table whose elements are to be iterated over.

@luau/global/ipairs.documentation: Returns an iterator function and the table for use in a for loop.

@luau/global/loadstring/param/0.documentation: The specified string to be loaded as Lua code.

@luau/global/loadstring.documentation: Returns the provided code as a function that can be executed.

@luau/global/next/param/1.documentation: The last key that was previously retrieved from a call to next.

@luau/global/next.documentation: An iterator function for use in for loops.

@luau/global/pairs/param/0.documentation: A table whose elements are to be iterated over.

@luau/global/pairs.documentation: Returns an iterator function and the provided table for use in a for loop.

@luau/global/pcall/param/0.documentation: The function to be called in protected mode.

@luau/global/pcall/param/1.documentation: The arguments to send to func when executing.

@luau/global/pcall.documentation:
Runs the provided function and catches any error it throws, returning the
function's success and its results.

@luau/global/print/param/0.documentation: Any number of arguments to be outputted.

@luau/global/print.documentation: Prints all provided values to the output.

@luau/global/rawequal.documentation: Returns whether v1 is equal to v2, bypassing their metamethods.

@luau/global/rawget.documentation: Gets the real value of table[index], bypassing any metamethods.

@luau/global/rawset/param/1.documentation: The index to set in t to a specified value. Must be different from nil.

@luau/global/rawset/param/2.documentation: The value to be set to a specified index in table t.

@luau/global/rawset.documentation: Sets the real value of table[index], bypassing any metamethods.

@luau/global/select/param/0.documentation: The index of the argument to return all arguments after in args. or must be "#".

@luau/global/select.documentation: Returns all arguments after the given index.

@luau/global/setfenv/param/0.documentation:
Either a function or a number that specifies the function at that
stack level.

@luau/global/setfenv/param/1.documentation: The function environment table to set for the specified function.

@luau/global/setmetatable/param/0.documentation: The table to set the metatable of.

@luau/global/setmetatable/param/1.documentation: If nil, the metatable of the given table t is removed. Otherwise, the metatable to set for the given table t.

@luau/global/tonumber/param/0.documentation: The object to be converted into a number.

@luau/global/tonumber/param/1.documentation: The numerical base to convert arg into.

@luau/global/tonumber.documentation: Returns the provided value converted to a number, or nil if impossible.

@luau/global/tostring/param/0.documentation: The object to be converted into a string.

@luau/global/tostring.documentation: Returns the provided value converted to a string, or nil if impossible.

@luau/global/type/param/0.documentation: The object to return the type of.

@luau/global/type.documentation: Returns the basic type of the provided object.

@luau/global/unpack/param/0.documentation: The list of elements to be unpacked.

@luau/global/unpack/param/1.documentation: The starting index to unpack from.

@luau/global/unpack/param/2.documentation: The number of elements to unpack.

@luau/global/unpack.documentation: Returns all elements from the given list as a tuple.

@luau/global/xpcall/param/0.documentation: The function to be called in protected mode.

@luau/global/xpcall/param/1.documentation: The function to be used as an error handle if xpcall catches an error.

@luau/global/xpcall.documentation: Similar to pcall() except it uses a custom error handler.

@roblox/global/delay/param/0.documentation:
The amount of time that this function will be queued before being
executed.

@roblox/global/delay/param/1.documentation: The function that will be executed once delayTime seconds have passed.

@roblox/global/delay.documentation:
Schedules a function to be called on the next Heartbeat after the given
duration (in seconds) has passed, with throttling.

@roblox/global/DebuggerManager.documentation:
Refers to the DebuggerManager, which acts as an interface for the Lua
debugger feature.

@roblox/global/elapsedTime.documentation:
Returns the amount of time in seconds that the current instance of Roblox
has been running for.

@roblox/global/gcinfo.documentation: Returns the total memory heap size in kilobytes.

@roblox/global/LoadLibrary/param/0.documentation: The name of the library that should be loaded in.

@roblox/global/LoadLibrary.documentation: Returns a built-in Roblox library by name.

@roblox/global/PluginManager.documentation:
Refers to the PluginManager, a deprecated singleton that was previously
required to create plugins.

@roblox/global/printidentity.documentation:
Prints "Current identity is X", where X corresponds to the current
thread's security context level.

@roblox/global/require/param/0.documentation:
The ModuleScript that will be executed to retrieve the return value it
provides.

@roblox/global/require.documentation:
Returns the value that was returned by the given ModuleScript, running it
if it has not been run yet.

@roblox/global/settings.documentation:
Returns the GlobalSettings object, which can be used to access settings
objects that configure Roblox Studio's behavior.

@roblox/global/spawn/param/0.documentation: The function that will be executed.

@roblox/global/spawn.documentation:
Calls a function immediately through the engine scheduler, with
throttling.

@roblox/global/tick.documentation:
Returns the amount of time in seconds since the Unix epoch according to
this device's time.

@roblox/global/time.documentation:
Returns the amount of time in seconds that has elapsed since the current
game instance started running.

@roblox/global/typeof/param/0.documentation: The Lua type that will have its type checked.

@roblox/global/typeof.documentation:
Returns the type of the given object as a string, also supporting
Roblox-specific types (e.g. Vector3).

@roblox/global/UserSettings.documentation:
Returns the UserSettings object, which is used to read information from
the current user's game menu settings.

@roblox/global/version.documentation:
Returns the current version of Roblox as a string, which includes the
generation, version, patch and commit.

@roblox/global/wait/param/0.documentation: Specifies how long the thread should yield for.

@roblox/global/wait.documentation:
Yields the current thread until the specified amount of time in seconds
have elapsed, with throttling.

@roblox/global/warn/param/0.documentation:
This function accepts any number of arguments, and will attempt to
convert them into strings which will then be joined together with
spaces between them.

@roblox/global/warn.documentation:
Behaves similarly to print, except with more distinct formatting (yellow);
intended for messages which describe potential problems.
